arms.ftoken_self: the task's own prompt + its demo-0 token (zero practice, zero weights changed)
arms.lora: the one-demo rank-16 LoRA (18.7 MB), demo 0 (recorded on 17 tasks; the 4 development tasks 35, 36, 39, 42 are scored now with the same adapters at the same states)
arms.lora_d1: the one-demo LoRA from demo 1 (recorded, 298 of 420)

hypotheses.H2a: ftoken_self non-inferior to lora at -0.10 (two-level bootstrap, one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference)
hypotheses.Z: ftoken_self > zero-shot pi0.5 (6 of 420): exact sign test, p < 0.05
hypotheses.claim: the token matches the LoRA only if BOTH H2a and H2b hold (the lesson of the second-demo retraction)
hypotheses.cost: bytes per task 18.4 KB against 18.7 MB

metrics.plan: the overhaul's FOLD: a factor token (lifelong_ood/policy/token_fold.py; a learned key and value per layer appended to the prompt's cache; every policy weight frozen; 18.4 KB fp16) fitted on the arrival's one demo (experiments/f4_fold.py: the same frames and chunks the one-demo LoRA trains on; the demo is never executed)
metrics.tasks: the 21 held-out tasks; init states 30-49; SERVE_SEED 0; 420 paired episodes per arm
metrics.written_before: any token episode at init states 30-49
